definition: Media content (images, audio, video, or text) that has been generated or significantly altered using AI, as opposed to being captured directly from the real world.
details: Synthetic media spans both benign creative applications and more concerning uses like deepfakes, and its rapid growth has driven increased interest in provenance tracking and content authentication standards.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. Think of it this way: Media content (images, audio, video, or text) that has been generated or significantly altered using AI, as opposed to being captured directly from the real world. And here is the clever part: Synthetic media spans both benign creative applications and more concerning uses like deepfakes, and its rapid growth has driven increased interest in provenance tracking and content authentication standards. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Synthetic Media — giving a machine the gift of sight.
